description: This Java class implements a service for managing product mix configurations related to loan products in the Fineract platform. It provides methods to create, update, and delete product mix entries, handling restrictions and data integrity issues.

classes.name: ProductMixWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing product mix configurations, including creation, update, and deletion of product mix entries, with data validation and exception handling.

methods.name: createProductMix
methods.description: Creates new product mix entries for a given product, handling restrictions and data validation.

methods.name: updateProductMix
methods.description: Updates existing product mix entries for a product, including adding, removing, or replacing restricted products.

methods.name: deleteProductMix
methods.description: Deletes all product mix entries associated with a given product.

methods.name: findByProductIdIfProvided
methods.description: Retrieves a LoanProduct by ID or throws an exception if not found.

methods.name: getRestrictedProducts
methods.description: Fetches a map of restricted product IDs to LoanProduct objects based on a set of string IDs.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Logs and throws an exception for data integrity issues encountered during database operations.

methods.name: updateRestrictionsForProduct
methods.description: Removes restrictions that are no longer present in the new set of restricted IDs.

methods.name: createNewProductMix
methods.description: Creates new ProductMix instances for a list of restricted products.

methods.name: updateRestrictedIds
methods.description: Removes existing ProductMix entries that are no longer restricted.

methods.name: getProductIdsFromCollection
methods.description: Extracts product IDs from a collection of ProductMix objects.
